What are the similarities & differences between HMPV and COVID-19?

Like COVID-19, people infected with HMPV complain of fever, cough, sore throat, wheezing and shortness of breath. Both diseases can spread through respiratory droplets

nodes.text:
What are the similarities & differences between HMPV and COVID-19?

Like COVID-19, people infected with HMPV complain of fever, cough, sore throat, wheezing and shortness of breath. Both diseases can spread through respiratory droplets and by contacting contaminated surfaces.
